name: BlackCat Ransomware
description: A financially motivated ransomware operation known for data theft, extortion, and disruption of essential services.
mitigation: Require multifactor authentication, patch internet-facing systems, segment networks, and maintain tested offline backups.

name: Cloud Credential Phishing
description: Convincing login pages and social-engineering messages are used to capture employee credentials and session tokens.
mitigation: Use phishing-resistant MFA, monitor unusual sign-ins, and block newly observed malicious domains.

name: Edge Device Exploitation
description: Automated scanning identifies unpatched gateways and management interfaces that may provide initial network access.
mitigation: Apply vendor updates, restrict administrative access, and review device logs for suspicious activity.

name: Business Email Compromise
description: Attackers impersonate trusted contacts to redirect payments or convince employees to disclose sensitive information.
mitigation: Verify payment changes out of band, enforce email authentication, and train staff to recognize impersonation attempts.
